whenToUse: People want to ask again with the question slightly changed.
Fixing a typo or a missing condition.
Changing an earlier part of the conversation to go in another direction.
whenNotToUse: Keeping the question and only getting a new answer (use regenerate response).
Work conversations where edit history must be kept.

alternatives.name: Regenerate Response
alternatives.reason: Getting a new answer to the same question.

alternatives.name: Chat Interface
alternatives.reason: The whole conversation where questions and answers pile up.

accessibility: Pressing edit moves focus to the input with the original text selected.
Cancel or Esc returns to the original state and the edit button.
That it answered again is announced with role=status.
The input is named Edit question.
